message.content:
**UNO – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What Happens | |---------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 1 000 points (or finish a set number of rounds). Points come from opponents’ remaining cards when you play your last one. | | **Deck** | Standard UNO deck has 108 cards:
• 25 Red, 25 Yellow, 25 Green, 25 Blue
• Each color contains two copies of numbers 0–9 and special action cards.
• Four Wild cards & four Wild Draw Four cards. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle all cards.
• Deal each player seven face‑up cards.
• Place the rest as a draw pile; flip top card to start discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately. | --- ### Turn Flow 1. **Draw Phase** - At turn start, if you cannot legally play a card, you *must* draw one from the draw pile. - You may keep this drawn card only if it can be played on the spot. 2. **Play Phase** - Play exactly one card onto the discard pile or pass if no legal move exists. - Legal plays: - Same colour as top card. - Same number/face value. - Matching action symbol (*Skip*, *Reverse*, *Draw Two*) regardless of colour. - Any Wild card (`Wild` or `Wild Draw Four`). 3. **Action Cards** - **Skip:** Next player loses their turn. - **Reverse:** Order reverses direction (two players → skip next). - **Draw Two (+2):** Next player draws two cards then skips. - **Wild:** Player chooses new active colour. - **Wild Draw Four (+4):** Player chooses new colour; next player draws four unless they challenge. 4. **Calling “UNO”** - When you have just one card left, shout “UNO!” before ending your turn. Failure to do so results in drawing two penalty cards if another player calls out before the next round starts. 5. **Winning a Round** - First player to empty hand wins the round. Score equals sum of opponent hands' values: ``` Numbered cards: Face value Specials: Skip / Reverse / Draw Two = 20 pts Wild / Wild Draw Four = 50 pts ``` 6. **Game End** - Continue until someone reaches target score (commonly 1000) or agreed upon rounds finished. --- #### Common Variations | Variation | Effect | |-----------|--------| | **Stacking** | Players may stack multiple +2/+4 cards instead of drawing. | | **No Wild Draw Four Challenge** | Simplifies gameplay—no challenges allowed. | | **Custom Deck Sizes** | Use fewer colours or add extra wild types. | Enjoy! 🎉
